variants.prompt: A stunning young woman with fiery auburn locks cascading down her back in loose, effortless waves, gazes intently with deep, soulful green eyes set in a heart-shaped face from the shadows of a dimly lit penthouse suite. Warm, golden skin glows under the soft, sultry lighting. She exudes confidence in sheer black lingerie, paired with thigh-high stockings and stiletto heels, finished with a delicate choker and bold red lip. Captured in a tight medium shot, her expressive eyes and relaxed posture convey a sultry, inviting air amidst the opulent city skyline visible through floor-to-ceiling windows.
